title: Governor's Mansion (Tobolsk, Russia)
scope: The Governor’s Mansion exterior as it appeared when the former imperial family was held at Tobolsk in 1917.
limitations: Exterior is dated to September 1917, when the photo-documented timber vestibule, balcony and enclosure were in place. The dated view represents the documented internment period.
Historic placement uses the extant masonry outline and original river-town grade. Finish colors, pent roof detailing, rear windows, street fencing and small fittings are approximate.
